responsibility: Declares the MPFR interop layer for GCC real constants. It exposes the routines that convert REAL_VALUE_TYPE values to MPFR and reconstruct REAL_VALUE_TYPE values from MPFR using either a tree type or a real_format, providing the interface used by MPFR-backed folding code such as built-in math constant evaluation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the MPFR interop routines for converting between REAL_VALUE_TYPE and MPFR numbers; unlike gcc/realmpfr.cc it is just the interface, and unlike gcc/real.h it is narrowly scoped to MPFR conversion rather than the full internal real-number API.
